title: Add pre-run hook for port run
description: Add a pre-run lifecycle hook that executes before port run starts a host process and can provide environment overrides such as DATABASE_URL pointing at <branch>.<domain>:5432. Include failing e2e/unit coverage first.
close_reason: Implemented pre-run hook support for port run with env override coverage.

title: Fix prune current-worktree exit test
description: bunx vitest run src/commands/prune.test.ts currently fails in the test named "exits current worktree before pruning it". The assertion at src/commands/prune.test.ts:190 expects mocks.exit to have been called, but it was not. This reproduces independently from the pre-run hook changes and caused the full suite to fail before timing out.
